notes.title: Conveyance 1.0 Released Today!
notes.content:
Hi all, well we're super excited here to finally announce Conveyance 1.0 has been released. The big green "Publish Now" button was pressed today (on purpose too), a smidge ahead of schedule.

Please keep an eye on the Workshop discussions area for news and updates, and please do feel free to let us know your thoughts, comments and feedback. The discussions area also contains some links to introduction and tutorial videos which we hope to expand upon over the coming weeks and months.

With that said it's over and out for now.

John

notes.title: Color Palette Editor
notes.content:
With only a few weeks to go until release, and just in the nick of time, we have completed the Color Palette Editor.

This tool enables custom colors to be used for all the different factory recipes. Perhaps you don't like our color choices (surely not), perhaps you want to create your own recipe theme (fluoro, greyscale), or perhaps you have some level of color blindness, if so then this is the tool for you...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647812/30a0a93307d9d66144145304cd4028a157391127.gif[/img]

notes.title: Conveyor Shape Edit Tool
notes.content:
Super pleased to announce the [b]Append Shape[/b] tool will be included in our shiny 1.0 release next February.

This tool allows rapid pre-configured shape placement of
[list]
[*] Left and right 90° bends
[*] Left and right U shaped bends
[*] Left and right, Up and Down 3D loop
[/list]
We've put together a short video showing each of the shape actions.

[previewyoutube=bVAR2Y1Q4fk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Conveyance Release Date
notes.content:
We're excited to advise Conveyance will be released February 10, 2022!

This leaves us just 7 more weeks to tighten all the machine mounts, solder the processor chips and check for any dodgy conveyor belts.

In the meantime we've added some new posts in our [b]Discussions[/b] area, including some links to new tutorial videos. Please grab an Eggnog and take a look...

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1838100/discussions/0/5116650215563132571/]Tutorial Videos[/url]

That's it for now!
